contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IV CRIS PVS NOBC ; R/ CAESARVM NOSTRORVM

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Crispus (317-326), issue of 321-324, Reece period 16. Obverse description: Youthful bullnecked bust diademed with triple fillet right. Obverse inscription: IV CRIS PVS NOBC. Reverse description: Vow in wreath surrounding VOT / X. Reverse inscription: CAESARVM NOSTRORVM. In exergue: STR followed by crescent. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 19.3mm,…
